# Task-board status filtering — effective specification v1

## REQ-STATUS-01: exact status filter
`taskboard.service.list_tasks(tasks, *, status=None)` accepts `todo`, `doing`, or
`done`. When status is supplied, return only Task objects whose status exactly
matches it. Do not convert case or trim input.

## REQ-STATUS-02: invalid status
Any other non-None status, including the empty string, upper-case `TODO`, leading
or trailing whitespace, or a value of a different type, must raise ValueError.
Validation applies even when the task sequence is empty. Do not accept substrings.

## REQ-COMPAT-01: default and ordering
When status is None, return all tasks in the original input order. Always return
a new list. Preserve duplicates and Task object identity.

## REQ-COMPAT-02: input immutability
Do not mutate the input sequence or its Task objects. Accept tuple inputs and
empty sequences. Keep the Task dataclass and public function signature compatible.

## Verification sources
Feature: `demo/tests/test_status_filter.py`.
Compatibility: `demo/tests/test_regression.py`.
Implementation: `demo/before/taskboard/service.py`, symbol `list_tasks`.
The same test files must be used against the before and after snapshots.

# CSV export format (unrelated to the status task)

Export uses UTF-8, comma separators and a header with task_id,title,status.
This specification does not change list behavior. No export modification is
requested by the status-filter development task.

"""Run the sample: python -m taskboard --data demo/data/tasks.json --status todo."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from .service import Task, list_tasks

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--data", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--status")
args = parser.parse_args()
tasks = [Task(**item) for item in json.loads(args.data.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))]
print(json.dumps([task.__dict__ for task in list_tasks(tasks, status=args.status)], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

"""Original task-board listing behaviors which the change must preserve."""
from taskboard.service import Task, list_tasks


def test_default_preserves_input_order():
    tasks = [Task("9", "later", "done"), Task("1", "first", "todo")]
    assert list_tasks(tasks) == tasks
    assert list_tasks(tasks, status=None) == tasks


def test_default_returns_fresh_list_without_mutation():
    item = Task("1", "spec", "todo")
    tasks = [item, item]
    result = list_tasks(tasks)
    assert result == tasks and result is not tasks
    assert result[0] is item and result[1] is item
    result.clear()
    assert tasks == [item, item]


def test_default_accepts_tuple_and_empty():
    task = Task("1", "spec", "todo")
    assert list_tasks((task,)) == [task]
    assert list_tasks([]) == []
    assert list_tasks(()) == []


def test_existing_unknown_task_status_is_preserved_without_filter():
    task = Task("1", "old imported item", "archived")
    assert list_tasks([task]) == [task]

              project_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, path VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
              kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
              content LONGTEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(project_id,path)
            ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

SELECT path,kind,sha256,content,(CASE WHEN LOCATE(?,LOWER(content))>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN LOCATE(?,LOWER(content))>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN LOCATE(?,LOWER(content))>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN LOCATE(?,LOWER(content))>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN LOCATE(?,LOWER(content))>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN LOCATE(?,LOWER(content))>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN LOCATE(?,LOWER(content))>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS relevance FROM sdd_materials WHERE project_id=? AND kind=? HAVING relevance>0 ORDER BY relevance DESC,path ASC LIMIT ?
